Key confirmations from search results:
- The TaskState enum defines: TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED (created), TASK_STATE_WORKING (actively processing), TASK_STATE_COMPLETED (terminal), TASK_STATE_FAILED (terminal), TASK_STATE_CANCELLED (terminal), TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED (interrupted), and TASK_STATE_REJECTED
- State transitions are: submitted: Initial task creation; working: Agent begins execution; completed: Agent successfully finishes; failed: Unrecoverable error; input_required: Agent needs additional user input; canceled: User or system cancels the task
- Stream Termination: When a task reaches a terminal or interrupted state (e.g., COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED, REJECTED, or INPUT_REQUIRED), the server closes the stream
- The agent MAY immediately continue Task processing after receiving the credential, without a requirement that clients send a follow-up message
- Agents MUST transition the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED and MUST include a TaskStatus message explaining the required authorization
- A task which has reached a terminal state (completed, canceled, rejected, or failed) can't be restarted
